test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If ({x}+(1)/({x)})=5, then the value of (x⁵+(1)/(x⁵)) is:
solution:
Given:

x + 1/x = 5

Formula used:

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a + b)³ = a³ + 3ab(a + b) + b³

Calculation:

x + 1/x = 5

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 5² – 2

⇒ 23

x³ + 1/x³

⇒ 5³ – 3(5)

⇒ 125 – 15

⇒ 110

x⁵ + 1/x⁵ = (x² + 1/x²)( x³ + 1/x³) – (x + 1/x)

⇒ 23 × 110 – 5

⇒ 2530 – 5

⇒ 2525

∴ x⁵ + 1/x⁵ is 2525.
